tools.name: voice_school_info
tools.description: Public description, policy, and catalog links for Voice School online vocal lesson requests.

tools.name: list_lesson_options
tools.description: List active lesson services and prices for a coach from the live Voice School database.

tools.name: search_lesson_availability
tools.description: Find free requestable lesson times using coach working windows and busy intervals. The response never includes private learner data.

tools.name: create_lesson_request
tools.description: Create a request-first lead for an online vocal lesson. Requires name and at least one contact method. This never confirms a lesson or creates a private schedule item.

tools.name: upsert_trainer_social_link
tools.description: Add or update a public round social icon link for a Voice School trainer. Requires SOCIAL_POSTS_MCP_WRITE_TOKEN as write_token.

tools.name: upsert_social_channel
tools.description: Add or update a social channel/group that trainer posts are attached to. Requires SOCIAL_POSTS_MCP_WRITE_TOKEN as write_token.

tools.name: create_social_post_draft
tools.description: Create or update a trainer social post with SEO title, description, keywords, tags, original source URL and ordered text/video blocks. Requires SOCIAL_POSTS_MCP_WRITE_TOKEN as write_token.

tools.name: publish_social_post
tools.description: Publish a prepared trainer social post after source URL validation. Requires SOCIAL_POSTS_MCP_WRITE_TOKEN as write_token.

tools.name: list_social_posts
tools.description: List published trainer social posts with canonical and original source URLs.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_social_posts · Private data: list_lesson_options, search_lesson_availability, create_lesson_request · Public sink: create_social_post_draft, publish_social_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_social_posts · Private data: list_lesson_options, search_lesson_availability, create_lesson_request · Public sink: create_social_post_draft, publish_social_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
